deliverables.notes: One of three equally weighted written assignments totalling 12%. Submitted via Gradescope. Late submissions accepted up to 48 hours without penalty; 20% per day after that; not accepted beyond 96 hours past deadline.

deliverables.title: Quizzes (Best 6 of 8)
deliverables.notes: 8 quizzes total via WebAssign; best 6 count. First quiz open during the week of Sept 16. Due dates posted on OWL. First 2 missed quizzes do not require academic consideration; additional missed quizzes reweighted to final exam.
deliverables.ambiguity_reason: Exact due dates for all 8 quizzes are posted on OWL but not listed in the syllabus; only the first quiz's week is given. Recurrence cadence is approximate.

deliverables.title: iClicker Lecture Participation
deliverables.notes: In-class participation via iClicker. Graded on % of questions answered (not correctness): ≥80%=4/4, 70–79%=3.2/4, 60–69%=2.4/4, 50–59%=2/4, 40–49%=1.6/4, <40%=0. Long-term absences (3+ consecutive classes) with academic consideration will result in mark adjustment.

deliverables.title: Midterm Test
deliverables.notes: In-person, 120 minutes (7:30–9:30pm). Covers weeks 1–7. Closed book, no calculators or electronic devices. Makeup tentatively scheduled for Friday October 31, 7:30–9:30pm.

deliverables.title: Final Exam
deliverables.notes: In-person, cumulative, 180 minutes. Scheduled during exam period (December 11–22, 2025) by the Office of the Registrar; exact date TBA. Closed book, no calculators or electronic devices.
deliverables.ambiguity_reason: Exact date and time not stated in the syllabus; described as TBA within the Dec 11–22 exam period.
